blocking_gates: Every target must reconstruct within the declared error/conditioning gate
Full spectral support and surrogate dye/base uncertainty remain unresolved
Instrument-density inversion does not establish absolute sensitivity/exposure calibration
Independent photographic colour validation required before any Profile registration
dye_source: Fitted to Kodak Pro Image 100 datasheet E-4L (July 1997) midscale-neutral minus D-min spectral density (see ProImage100_datasheet_curves.json), projected onto the Vision3 ECN-2 image-dye set as surrogate basis
dye_uncertainty: Surrogate-basis method: Portra's actual couplers are not published, so the mid-minus-min aggregate was decomposed onto warped Vision3 dyes (shift parameter +/-25 nm, width-scale cyan 0.85-1.15, magenta and yellow 0.5-2; the peak moves by shift x width, see peak_shift_nm). Aggregate reconstruction RMSE 0.0135 D, max abs 0.1243 D over the MEASURED support. Per-layer separation is model-dependent; treat off-peak/crosstalk values as ~+/-0.05 and the whole set as provisional.

responsivity.source: ISO 5-3 / ANSI CGATS.5-1993 Status M, values as embedded in ArgyllCMS xspect.c (denM), cross-validated: same file's Status A table matches this project's StatusA_ISO5-3.json exactly. Verified 2026-09-09 against Table 4 of ANSI/ISO 5-3-1995 (ANSI/NAPM IT2.18-1996, law.resource.org/pub/us/cfr/ibr/001/aimm.it2.18.1996.pdf): all 42 explicitly tabulated log-product entries match; the 2009 edition and the extrapolated tails are not covered by that check.

integration.rule: uniform point sum, inclusive endpoints; linear responsivity interpolation within its supplied support

modifications: New SpektraLab spectral forward/inverse and coverage diagnostics on supplied data/operator. Failed measurements retained, spectra and exposure axes unmodified. Not an emulsion Profile.
